title: Bronze ingest — Event Hubs JSON
prompt:
You're starting Stratus, a 5 TB/day device-telemetry platform on Microsoft Fabric. Three downstream consumers: a real-time ops dashboard (<15min lag), a weekly exec report, and a DS feature store. The primary source is Azure Event Hubs delivering JSON envelopes; schema evolves quarterly. This is session 1 — no prior decisions exist.

Design the bronze ingestion. Commit to a specific approach. Justify each choice against the 15-min ops-dashboard SLA and the 5 TB/day volume. Name the trade-off you're accepting.
